title_yt: If You Saved 2 Cents a Day Since 2013... #Shorts
title_fb: If you saved two cents a day since 2013, you could buy GTA 6
hook: If you saved two cents a day since 2013, you could buy GTA 6.
open_loop: The hook promises two cents a day buys GTA 6 (13 years since GTA 5). The friend says it is too small; the answer arrives only at the store counter in the last ~8 s ($96.22 vs $79.99).
payoff: Two cents a day for 4,811 days is $96.22: enough for the $79.99 game with $16.23 left, while the friend who laughed has no money when GTA 6 comes out.

lines.text: If you saved two *cents a day since *2013, you could buy *GTA 6.
lines.say: If you saved two cents a day since twenty thirteen, you could buy G T A six.
lines.visual: Frame 0: Benny (everyday hoodie, your avatar) holds up a coin, smug, hopping; big coin jar prop and a headline '2 CENTS A DAY' already visible. At 'since 2013' a badge 'SINCE 2013' slams in; on 'GTA 6' a plain white outlined text headline 'GTA 6' (no logo, no game lettering) with a snap-zoom.
Badge 'YEAR 2013'. Benny drops a coin in an almost empty jar, clink sfx, happy expression. Hooded stranger (the friend) walks in from the right.

lines.text: Your friend says it is too small.
lines.visual: Stranger (flip, point, smug) leans over the jar and laughs; bubble 'TOO SMALL!' (tail toward the stranger). Benny worried, then determined. A coin bonks off Benny's head.

Deliberate beat: headline '13 YEARS' stamps in, counter ticks from 0 to 13 with suffix ' YEARS' while the jar visibly grows (jar prop scale up) and coins rain behind. Benny drops one coin per tick, face turns from determined to tired, then a tiny gray-hair gag is not needed; he just sweats and keeps going. Stranger scrolls a phone in the back.

lines.say: Then G T A six comes out.
lines.visual: Badge 'NOV 19, 2026'. Plain text headline 'GTA 6 IS OUT' (no logo, no art). Benny gasps happily, hop; ding sfx. Stranger in the back stops scrolling.
Stranger turns out empty pockets, expression broke, slumps; bubble 'NO MONEY?' and a single sad cash prop floats away. Benny smug, arms crossed, jar next to him.

lines.text: You carry the heavy jar inside.
lines.visual: Heavy-jar gag: Benny hugs the huge jar prop (layer front), pose slump, drifts slowly right with camera shake, thud sfx each step, sweat; bubble 'SO HEAVY!'. Floor shows a plain 'STORE' headline (generic, no brand).

Counter-gag: the hooded stranger works as the cashier behind a counter, counting coins one by one (bubble '1... 2... 3...', tick sfx, camera zoom-out); then stamp 'SMASH!' as the jar breaks and coins rain; gold counter climbs to $96.22. Keep to stamp, counter, coins.
Benny hero pose, happy, hands over cash at the counter; generic blank game box (no logo/art); badge '-$79.99' then counter '$16.23 LEFT' in gold; confetti burst. Small badge 'NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE'.

lines.text: Would you save daily, or spend it *all?
lines.visual: Two list rows: 'A: SAVE DAILY' and 'B: SPEND IT ALL'. Benny points at the viewer, thinking expression, jar on one side, stranger shrugging on the other.
Benny points at the viewer and smiles; headline 'COMMENT A OR B' in gold. Hard cut right after the last word (tail ~0.3 s).

facts_used.claim: GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026; Standard Edition is $79.99.
GTA 5 launched about Sept 17, 2013 (inferred from an article dated Sept 20, 2013 saying $1B in 3 days). Speech says only 'since 2013'; do not show a Sept 17 date on screen.
Fans joke about '13 years since GTA 5' and about GTA launch hype (the 13-year angle used for the thirteen-years beat).

math_check: Python: Sept 17, 2013 to Nov 19, 2026 = 4,811 days (13.17 years). 4,811 x $0.02 = $96.22. $96.22 - $79.99 = $16.23 left (on screen only; before sales tax). 1 cent a day would be only $48.11 (not used). Spoken 'ninety-six dollars' is the rounded-down $96.22.
word_count_note: 73 counting the 'say' field (G T A six = 4 words, twenty thirteen = 2); 69 counting the on-screen text. Both inside 60-75.
timing_note: Present tense 'comes out' is true on release day (Nov 19). Post on Nov 19, or at the earliest Nov 18 (it still reads as a countdown headline: change line 5 visual only if posted early).
ip_notes: 'GTA 6' appears only as plain spoken/written topic text. No Rockstar characters, logos, wordmark lettering/colors, footage, art style or music. The game box is blank and generic. City is plain cartoon.
description_note: Add 'Not financial advice. Hypothetical example.' to the description. Hashtags: #gta6 #savingmoney #money.
changes_from_previous: Hook now carries the span ('since 2013') and keeps one breath (14 words, clarity over the 12-word cap). Line 2 is now 'you' (Benny = viewer avatar) and short; line 3 gives the friend a reason ('it is too small'). Old line 4 is now 'You keep going for thirteen years', a deliberate beat with a counter. Old line 5 ('Game day came, everyone was broke') is split into two plain present-tense sentences that re-name GTA 6 and show the friend's fate; no crowd. The moral line 'Tiny habits beat panic' is cut; the story carries it. Added a heavy-jar gag and a cashier counting coins one by one so $96 feels earned; 'sixteen dollars left' now shows on screen only to free words. Ending is now 'Would you save daily, or spend it all? Comment A or B.' GTA 6 is named twice, the 13-years-since-GTA-5 angle drives the beat. Scene 8 trimmed to stamp, counter and coins.
